newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Gilts penned in by 114-12 and 115-02.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Gilts penned in by 114-12 and 115-02.

text.p: September gilt futures will be confined to a narrow range on Wednesday penned in by 114-12 on the downside and 115-02 to the upside, technical analysts said.
The market will struggle to move out of that range ahead of the Bank of England's decision on interest rates on Thursday, they added.

"We'll need either a strong lead from other markets or good UK news to be able to take out 115-02, so I expect range trading to prevail," said Andy Cossor, fixed income analyst at Technical Data. "If the market does go up, it will drift back off pretty quickly."
